scope.market_definition: The Europe Paclitaxel market encompasses the distribution and sale of Paclitaxel, a chemotherapy medication used to treat various cancers. Key participants include distributors, wholesalers, resellers, system integrators, service providers, and channel partners operating within the pharmaceutical supply chain across Europe.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of Paclitaxel through various intermediaries.

accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance.

opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes.

engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. Skip to content

our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of

our community outreach programmes.

engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,

### Information You Can Trust

Chemocare.com is a comprehensive resource for cancer patients and their caregivers that provides
chemotherapy drug and side effect information, cancer wellness information, and links to additional
reliable resources and organizations.

All information provided on this website is created and reviewed by a multidisciplinary team at
Cleveland Clinic or is referenced from reliable medical and community resources.

### About

While undergoing cancer treatment at Cleveland Clinic, Scott Hamilton, an Olympic gold medalist in
figure skating, discovered that it was difficult to find a reliable online resource where
information about chemotherapy was presented in a clear, easy to understand and easy to locate
format. As a result, his idea to create a patient friendly website was born. Chemocare.com went
online in December 2002 to provide cancer patients and their caregivers with clear and accurate
information about chemotherapy, and to empower them to become active participants in their
treatment. Several updates to the site since 2002 include translating the website into Spanish,
becoming mobile friendly, educational videos, as well as continuing to add and update all FDA
approved drugs for the treatment of cancer.

## [Nutrition During Chemotherapy][48]

Practicing healthy eating habits throughout cancer treatment is essential. Staying hydrated and
maintaining muscle tissue with enough fluids, calories and nutrients can reduce treatment delays,
boost your immune system and help minimize debilitating side effects such as fatigue.

Navigating reliable, useful information can be overwhelming. We want to help you and your caregivers
with suggestions for maintaining a healthy diet during chemotherapy.

Cleveland Clinic or is referenced from reliable medical and community resources.

### About

While undergoing cancer treatment at Cleveland Clinic, Scott Hamilton, an Olympic gold medalist in
figure skating, discovered that it was difficult to find a reliable online resource where
information about chemotherapy was presented in a clear, easy to understand and easy to locate
format. As a result, his idea to create a patient friendly website was born. Chemocare.com went
online in December 2002 to provide cancer patients and their caregivers with clear and accurate
information about chemotherapy, and to empower them to become active participants in their
treatment. Several updates to the site since 2002 include translating the website into Spanish,
becoming mobile friendly, educational videos, as well as continuing to add and update all FDA
approved drugs for the treatment of cancer.

### [Drug Information][42]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

[View All][43] [Spanish][44]

### [Managing Side Effects][45]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

[View All][46] [Spanish][47]

## [Nutrition During Chemotherapy][48]

Practicing healthy eating habits throughout cancer treatment is essential. Staying hydrated and
maintaining muscle tissue with enough fluids, calories and nutrients can reduce treatment delays,
boost your immune system and help minimize debilitating side effects such as fatigue.

Navigating reliable, useful information can be overwhelming. We want to help you and your caregivers
with suggestions for maintaining a healthy diet during chemotherapy.

[Nutritional Information][49]

accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our

[ Who we are ][82]

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

ALVION PHARMACEUTICALS

# A science oriented pharmaceutical company

Developing and manufacturing noninfringing generic medicines in Europe.

# About us

Alvion is a science oriented pharmaceutical company developing and manufacturing non infringing
generic medicines in Europe. Collaborating with state of the art R&D centers in EU, Alvion is a
private and independent company focusing in R&D, IP, Quality, Regulatory and manufacturing of
generic and added value medicines, delivering an exceptional track record in the global
pharmaceutical market supplying millions of patients.

[Read more .][12]

# Why Alvion?

Developing, manufacturing, and promoting medicines in Europe, MENA, Canada, Australia, South Africa,
Australia, Asia and Latin America is the core business model of Alvion. **Focusing on delivering
innovation and best quality pharmaceuticals among the first companies prior the patent expiry while
offering flexible terms** and affordable medicines with an effective supply chain is major
competitive advantage of Alvion.

[Read more .][13]

[vision-card-icons]

## Our Vision

Alvion is a science pharmaceutical company offering difficult to develop and non-infringing products
to its partners, setting a new standard in generics by combining our experiences with an
understanding of the health care needs in a global level.

[flag-card-icons]

## Our Mission

Having diversified business model that enriches quality of life and delivers outstanding value to
all stakeholders.
[target-card-icons]

## Our Goal

is to become a leading and vertically integrated pharmaceutical company, establishing a global
presence, serving the healthcare communities and satisfying high performance employees.

Why collaborate with us:

# our partners’ success is our success

By raising the barrier of customer service and innovation, Alvion’s team is developing and producing
blockbuster molecules, registering the products across a wide territory. Alvion is offering a
complete and competitive “package” to its partners delivering end to end products and services at
all stages of the partnership.

[Read more .][14]

[alvion-collaborate]

# Partner with Alvion

Contact Business Development Department at [bd@alvionpharma.com][15]

# Innovation with a Global Presence

At Alvion, **we are rethinking pharmaceuticals with a new business model that creates the
pharmaceutical company of tomorrow.** We strive for a change that is clearly visible in the various
pharmaceutical markets, our model, processes and actions.

[Read more .][16]

[alvion-research]

# Research and Development

Developing in third parties’ high technology and non-infringing Intellectual Properties, often
patented technologies, Alvion is an IP powerhouse providing licensing rights to the largest
pharmaceutical companies in the world.

[Read more .][17]

# Products

Our people are a core aspect of Alvion’ s competitive advantage. We attract and retain key talents
with a high level of expertise and know-how who drive our business forward.

[Read more .][18]

# Innovations equals successful business

Alvion is welcoming business opportunities with multinational and strong local pharmaceutical
companies partnering with Alvion’s products via licensing agreements, both in the proprietary and
the supply.

# Our Sustainability Commitment

Alvion Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to creating a healthier future through responsible and
sustainable practices. Guided by **ESG principles**, we focus on reducing our environmental
footprint, continuously supporting our people and ensuring transparent and ethical corporate
governance.

[Read more .][20]

We are looking for talents. Should you wish to work with one of the most dynamic teams in the

## APECS – European pilot line for advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration

APECS (Advanced Packaging and Heterogeneous Integration for Electronic Components and Systems) is a
European pilot line established under the EU Chips Act. It provides industry, SMEs and research
organizations with access to technologies, infrastructure and expertise for chiplet innovation,
system integration and industrial deployment. By connecting development, testing and pilot-scale
manufacturing, APECS accelerates the transition from research to application and strengthens
Europe’s semiconductor ecosystem.

### Get in touch with our experts!

Don’t hesitate to contact us.

We look forward to your inquiry and will respond shortly.

[Direct contact][24]

integration.

A distributed European pilot line connecting design, manufacturing and testing into one continuous
workflow.

[Explore infrastructure][26]

### Who APECS is for

 

For industry, SMEs and research developing and scaling semiconductor technologies.

Access APECS via open calls or collaboration to develop and scale technologies without own
infrastructure.

## Access APECS – Europe's gateway to advanced packaging innovation

### Annual open access call

We invite players across the semiconductor value chain to submit project ideas for selected pilot
line technologies. This year's call starts on April 1, 2026.

[Learn more][36]

### Submit your inquiry

Whether developing chiplets, sensors, or complex systems, APECS helps bringing innovations to market
efficiently and reliably.

Our experts will get back to you shortly.

[Contact us][37]

## Funding

APECS is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of Austria,
Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Portugal, Spain, through the Chips for Europe Initiative.

Thanks to substantial funding from the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space
(BMFTR) and the federal states of Saxony, Berlin, Bavaria, Schleswig-Holstein, Baden-Württemberg,
North Rhine-Westphalia, Brandenburg, and Saxony-Anhalt, it will be possible to further expand the
R&D infrastructure in the coming years within the framework of the APECS pilot line.

## **CHAPPER healthcare – a leading global specialist pharmaceutical wholesaler, distributor and
## services provider**


# Welcome to CHAPPER healthcare

CHAPPER healthcare is a leading global pharmaceutical distributor and wholesaler, specialising in
importing and exporting pharmaceuticals to markets across the globe since 1975.
* Importer & exporter of unlicensed / non-registered medicines
* Rapid response to market shortages & emergency medicines
* Complete range of temperature-controlled logistical solutions
* Pharmaceutical distribution services
* Significant expertise supplying to UK healthcare market and worldwide

We are a truly global company and regularly export to more than 70 different countries. We have
longstanding relationships with clients across Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia and the Americas.

CHAPPER healthcare builds on its legacy of export and wholesale services, now serving as the
European market access and distribution arm of [AscellaHealth][47] to leverage our shared expertise
in supporting partners globally.


# Our core values

## Supply chain integrity and security

All procedures are GMDP (Good Manufacturing & Distribution Practice) compliant.

## Ethical way of doing business

Patient safety is paramount and central to our core values and procedures. Honesty and transparency
guide the way we act across all aspects of our business. We build relationships for the long-term.

## Service

We differentiate ourselves by our emphasis on service quality. Our team are experienced,
professional and multilingual. We are bonded by a shared goal of delivering medicines to customers
around the world in a safe and efficient way.

## Global outlook

We supply clients in over 75 countries across the globe in all inhabited continents, we are a truly
global business.

## Quality of offering

Quality applies to every aspect of our business from the quality of medicinal products we supply to
the quality of service we offer our customers.

### Information You Can Trust

Chemocare.com is a comprehensive resource for cancer patients and their caregivers that provides
chemotherapy drug and side effect information, cancer wellness information, and links to additional
reliable resources and organizations.

All information provided on this website is created and reviewed by a multidisciplinary team at
Cleveland Clinic or is referenced from reliable medical and community resources.

### About

While undergoing cancer treatment at Cleveland Clinic, Scott Hamilton, an Olympic gold medalist in
figure skating, discovered that it was difficult to find a reliable online resource where
information about chemotherapy was presented in a clear, easy to understand and easy to locate
format. As a result, his idea to create a patient friendly website was born. Chemocare.com went
online in December 2002 to provide cancer patients and their caregivers with clear and accurate
information about chemotherapy, and to empower them to become active participants in their
treatment. Several updates to the site since 2002 include translating the website into Spanish,
becoming mobile friendly, educational videos, as well as continuing to add and update all FDA
approved drugs for the treatment of cancer.

### [Drug Information][42]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

[View All][43] [Spanish][44]

### [Managing Side Effects][45]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

## [Nutrition During Chemotherapy][48]

Practicing healthy eating habits throughout cancer treatment is essential. Staying hydrated and
maintaining muscle tissue with enough fluids, calories and nutrients can reduce treatment delays,
boost your immune system and help minimize debilitating side effects such as fatigue.

Navigating reliable, useful information can be overwhelming. We want to help you and your caregivers
with suggestions for maintaining a healthy diet during chemotherapy.

chemotherapy drug and side effect information, cancer wellness information, and links to additional
reliable resources and organizations.

All information provided on this website is created and reviewed by a multidisciplinary team at
Cleveland Clinic or is referenced from reliable medical and community resources.

### About

While undergoing cancer treatment at Cleveland Clinic, Scott Hamilton, an Olympic gold medalist in
figure skating, discovered that it was difficult to find a reliable online resource where
information about chemotherapy was presented in a clear, easy to understand and easy to locate
format. As a result, his idea to create a patient friendly website was born. Chemocare.com went
online in December 2002 to provide cancer patients and their caregivers with clear and accurate
information about chemotherapy, and to empower them to become active participants in their
treatment. Several updates to the site since 2002 include translating the website into Spanish,
becoming mobile friendly, educational videos, as well as continuing to add and update all FDA
approved drugs for the treatment of cancer.

### [Drug Information][42]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

### [Managing Side Effects][45]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

## [Nutrition During Chemotherapy][48]

Practicing healthy eating habits throughout cancer treatment is essential. Staying hydrated and
maintaining muscle tissue with enough fluids, calories and nutrients can reduce treatment delays,
boost your immune system and help minimize debilitating side effects such as fatigue.

Navigating reliable, useful information can be overwhelming. We want to help you and your caregivers
with suggestions for maintaining a healthy diet during chemotherapy.

## [Romanian Pharmaceutical Wholesaler for Licensed EU Partners][14]

EAST PHARMA sources, supplies, and distributes pharmaceutical products — branded, generic, and OTC —
for licensed European wholesale partners. GDP-compliant. Romania-based. Operating since 2018.

[**CONTACT US → **][15]

Who we are

## A Romanian partner for regulated pharmaceutical operations

We provide European pharmaceutical companies with direct access to the Romanian market through a
platform built on compliance, operational discipline, and commercial reliability.

Romania maintains some of the lowest regulated pharmaceutical prices in the EU, making it a
structurally relevant source market.

Authorized for pharmaceutical wholesale distribution in Romania and operating under EU GDP
standards, we support licensed partners across sourcing, supply, distribution, parallel export
coordination, and market execution. Our role is to provide a structured and dependable operating
route for pharmaceutical companies working in a regulated environment.

[**ABOUT EAST PHARMA →**][16]

[
[GDP-compliant pharmaceutical distribution and coordination in Romania]
][17]

## What we support

***01 Supply and distribution****
*GDP-compliant sourcing, supply, and distribution of branded medicines, generics, and OTC products.

***02 Commercial coordination***
Structured local support for partners requiring reliable execution, communication, and coordination
in Romania.

***03 Regulatory coordination***
Careful handling of Romanian and EU documentation requirements across distribution-related
activities.

***04 Market entry support***
Practical guidance for pharmaceutical companies entering Romania, from initial engagement to
operational follow-through.

[
[Romanian pharmaceutical wholesaler supporting licensed EU partners]
][18]

## Why pharmaceutical partners choose EAST PHARMA

***01 GDP-based operating discipline***
We work through controlled processes shaped by EU GDP requirements and regulated wholesale practice.

***02 Romanian market execution***
We support sourcing, supply, distribution, and local coordination through a clear Romanian operating
structure.

***03 Qualified B2B focus***
We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies and serious commercial partners across regulated
distribution activity.

***04 Reliable long-term cooperation***
We build long-term relationships through clear communication, workable execution, and consistent
follow-through.

[**PARTNER WITH US →**][19]

We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies seeking a capable and dependable Romanian partner.
Whether the need is pharmaceutical supply, local coordination, distribution execution, or regulated
market support, we provide a structured wholesale platform, clear documentation, and dependable
operational follow-through from the outset.

[**EXPLORE SERVICES →**][21]

## [Romanian Pharmaceutical Wholesaler for Licensed EU Partners][14]

EAST PHARMA sources, supplies, and distributes pharmaceutical products — branded, generic, and OTC —
for licensed European wholesale partners. GDP-compliant. Romania-based. Operating since 2018.

[**CONTACT US → **][15]

Who we are

## A Romanian partner for regulated pharmaceutical operations

We provide European pharmaceutical companies with direct access to the Romanian market through a
platform built on compliance, operational discipline, and commercial reliability.

Romania maintains some of the lowest regulated pharmaceutical prices in the EU, making it a
structurally relevant source market.

Authorized for pharmaceutical wholesale distribution in Romania and operating under EU GDP
standards, we support licensed partners across sourcing, supply, distribution, parallel export
coordination, and market execution. Our role is to provide a structured and dependable operating
route for pharmaceutical companies working in a regulated environment.

[**ABOUT EAST PHARMA →**][16]

[
[GDP-compliant pharmaceutical distribution and coordination in Romania]
][17]

## What we support

***01 Supply and distribution****
*GDP-compliant sourcing, supply, and distribution of branded medicines, generics, and OTC products.

***02 Commercial coordination***
Structured local support for partners requiring reliable execution, communication, and coordination
in Romania.

***03 Regulatory coordination***
Careful handling of Romanian and EU documentation requirements across distribution-related
activities.

***04 Market entry support***
Practical guidance for pharmaceutical companies entering Romania, from initial engagement to
operational follow-through.

[
[Romanian pharmaceutical wholesaler supporting licensed EU partners]
][18]

## Why pharmaceutical partners choose EAST PHARMA

***01 GDP-based operating discipline***
We work through controlled processes shaped by EU GDP requirements and regulated wholesale practice.

***02 Romanian market execution***
We support sourcing, supply, distribution, and local coordination through a clear Romanian operating
structure.

***03 Qualified B2B focus***
We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies and serious commercial partners across regulated
distribution activity.

***04 Reliable long-term cooperation***
We build long-term relationships through clear communication, workable execution, and consistent
follow-through.

We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies seeking a capable and dependable Romanian partner.
Whether the need is pharmaceutical supply, local coordination, distribution execution, or regulated
market support, we provide a structured wholesale platform, clear documentation, and dependable
operational follow-through from the outset.

### EnCor Biotechnology Inc.

    ** Our goal is to be the leader in the development and commercialization of unique,
well-characterized antibody reagents for academic, biopharmaceutical and clinical research. We are
an established and well respected company and if you check out Google Scholar you will find that we
have been mentioned in the current literature well over 1,350 times as of November 2025, see
**[**here**][135]**. Many of our antibodies have been widely used for many years and are sold
through many vendors who charge higher prices than we do, see for examples **[**here**][136]** and
**[**here**][137]**. If we say that an antibody will work in a particular assay, rest assured that
it will, we know because we tested it and can show you the data. Since we design, develop,
characterize and manufacture all of the reagents we sell, we can also offer very competitive
pricing! To learn more about us press **[**here**][138]**.**

What We Do...

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:

unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

## BusKill: a USB kill cord

BusKill is a USB kill cord for your laptop. It is designed to protect your data if your device is
suddenly taken from you.

When the magnetic USB cable is disconnected (e.g., due to snatch-and-run theft), it triggers a
customisable security response: from locking your screen to shutting down or securely erasing
encryption keys.

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

### Clinical Trial Register

Search through multiple clinical trial registers in a single interface, connected to the drug
registration data and market data of PharmaFootpath.

This helps you to select a drug name or API, and then review global clinical trials currently
running with this.

### Drug Shortage Monitoring

Monitoring drug shortages is an important task, but the volume of information can be difficult to
manage.

PharmaFootpath collects and structures shortage information into a single interface, monitoring
trends to highlight the API with which there are increasing supply disruption signals.

## Built for Pharmaceutical Trade and Procurement

### Procurement Teams

Procurement teams can efficiently search multiple markets, compare pricing, and identify suppliers.

### Parallel Traders

Parallel traders can track product registrations, monitor competition, and find arbitrage
opportunities across EU markets.

### Clinical Trial Supply Teams

Clinical trial supply teams can identify global product availability and find new sourcing
opportunities.

### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers

Pharmaceutical wholesalers can find new suppliers, partners, and international trade opportunities.

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through

scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

What data sources does MedPath Trial use?
MedPath Trial aggregates data from ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP, EudraCT, and 12+ regulatory
agencies including FDA, EMA, NMPA, TGA, and Health Canada. All data is updated daily.
How does the AI research assistant work?
Our AI analyzes trial protocols, regulatory documents, and scientific literature to provide
insights. All AI-generated content includes source citations for verification.
Is the data on MedPath Trial free to access?
Basic search and trial information is free. Pro and Team plans unlock advanced features like AI
research, data export, and priority support.
How often is the data updated?
Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What data sources does MedPath Trial use?
MedPath Trial aggregates data from ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP, EudraCT, and 12+ regulatory
agencies including FDA, EMA, NMPA, TGA, and Health Canada. All data is updated daily.
How does the AI research assistant work?
Our AI analyzes trial protocols, regulatory documents, and scientific literature to provide
insights. All AI-generated content includes source citations for verification.
Is the data on MedPath Trial free to access?
Basic search and trial information is free. Pro and Team plans unlock advanced features like AI
research, data export, and priority support.
How often is the data updated?
Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

## Wholesale List

Welcome to Wholesalers Network.com. Our website contains a growing number of wholesale product
categories to choose from and thousands of wholesale companies on our B2B search directory. If
you’re a business looking to find some wholesale merchandise to sell online or offline then you can
start your search by clicking on the category of your choice or browse [wholesalers by country][9].
If you’re a business looking to get exposure for your wholesale company website you should visit
our [Company Submission][10] page. We also offer Advertising options for your wholesale company if
you want to maximize your exposure.

## Expanding Opportunities in the B2B Digital Landscape

In the world of wholesale and B2B commerce, access to reliable suppliers and structured directories
plays a crucial role in business growth. Platforms like provide businesses with the ability to
explore thousands of suppliers across multiple categories, helping retailers and entrepreneurs find
the right products to sell both online and offline.

As competition continues to increase, businesses must go beyond simply sourcing products—they need
to build efficient systems, maintain strong supplier relationships, and stay informed about market
trends. A well-organized sourcing strategy allows companies to reduce risks, improve margins, and
create more стабильный and scalable operations over time.

At the same time, the broader digital ecosystem continues to evolve, offering a wide variety of
platforms and services that reflect changing user behavior and global connectivity. From e-commerce
and logistics to entertainment and interactive platforms, each sector contributes to a more diverse
online environment.

Websites such as **[luckyspy.co.uk][11]** are part of this expanding digital landscape,
demonstrating how modern online platforms are designed to engage users and provide accessible
experiences across different industries.

For businesses operating in wholesale and distribution, understanding these broader trends can offer
valuable insights. By observing how digital platforms grow, attract users, and scale globally,
companies can apply similar principles to their own strategies and remain competitive in a rapidly
changing market.

Ultimately, success in B2B commerce comes from combining reliable sourcing, strategic thinking, and
adaptability. Those who continuously refine their processes and stay open to new opportunities will
be best positioned to grow and succeed in today’s interconnected world.

## WOW CONGRESS

**WOW CONGRESS** is a destination of a **synergetic idea** and **expression**, where magic unleashes
and harness the **collective wisdom**, **experience** and **energy of inspirational** **women** and
**men** of all ages and backgrounds in service of our values and to **promote**, **communicate** and
**amplify** the influence of women and men in the workplace and beyond. We are committed to
**eliminate** **gender discrimination** and giving back to our growing worldwide community.

**WOW CONGRESS **believes that true empowerment for women cannot be achieved unless women themselves
support and uplift each other**. **As we come together in** solidarity, **we recognize that
empowerment is not just about individual success**, but about creating a network **of**
encouragement **and** mutual support **that** fosters growth **for all women. **Empowered women
empower others, **and in this collective effort, we create an environment where women can thrive not
only for themselves but for the generations to come.** As the founder of WOW CONGRESS wisely states,
“Women are a blessing to the world, there is no world without women.” **This belief is central to
our mission, as we continue to strengthen our collective voice and power through connection,
understanding, and action.**

****WOW CONGRESS** desires to bring people from across the globe and discuss how to **empower**,
**reshape** and **advance woman** with the proposition through our exclusive events for the
professional including **Medical** and **Healthcare**, **Information Technology**, **Business
Management** etc, where women are supporting other woman **ambition**, **aspiration**, **agility**
and **spirituality** in competent world and where they discuss, debate and dissect what the future
holds in a vibrant atmosphere by experiencing **integrative**, **responsible** and **socially
holistic environment** of opportunities and possibilities.

## WOW AWARDS

**WOW AWARDS** exclusive gateway for **inspiring stories of woman** across profession, who have been
leaving their footprint by generating **impactful change**, **driven by diversity**, **equity**, and
**inclusion** are at the forefront of every decision they make by rediscovering themselves with a
token of **Emotion**, **Embrace**, **Empathy** along with the notion of **Emerging**,
**Encouraging**, **Empowering** and **Enlightening of kinship and leadership**.

We believe a profound transformation for women across the globe beside all ages and marked a
significant turning point for **elevating** and **empowering** of **womanhood** by considering the
key global policy document on gender equality. It also sets strategic objectives and actions for the
advancement of women and the achievement of gender equality.

ACTIONABLE SESSIONS

With sessions and topics ranging from clinical to marketing, creating a profitable practice, **it
challenges and change your perspective and strive you for the better career**, you always wanted. It
helps you finding the clinical position of your dreams and more, you will find yourself seeing more
progress in these 2 days than most do in an entire year!

INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGY

Admiring emerging issues and get hands-on with the **cutting-edge technology** in the industry and
competitive analysis be on the forefront of **research and innovation** to create a seamless and
steadfast workflow at your practice.

INFLUENCING SPEAKERS

Get inspired with the best and brightest minds in **Healthcare & Tech industry** during captivation
sessions and assertive hands-on workshops. Get influenced by the **leading experts** and learn what
it takes to bring your practice to the next level with enhanced and assured patient care.

EXPLORING THE NETWORK

Grab the moment of cognizance and inspired, motivated, and empowered. **Interact and connect with
the peers and mentors to find support, leadership opportunities with guidance**. Gather glorify and
celebrate 2 days of networking with like-minded individuals.

CONTINUING EDUCATION

Collectively, comprehensive sessions and hands-on workshops with tons of takeaways to **instantly
enhance your practice and workflow** as soon as you return to your practice.

TEAM BUILDING

**WOW environment** is an impacting, not only your team members learn in educational scientific
sessions specifically designed for them, but **it’s a chance for everyone to have fun, building a
stronger bond out of your working environment and empowered**.

At Zentiva, we provide health and wellbeing for all generations

We develop, produce, and deliver high-quality, affordable medicines to more than 100 million people
in over 40 countries across Europe. Our four manufacturing sites and a broad network of external
manufacturing partners ensure supply security. Zentiva employs more than 5,400 unique talents in
over 30 countries, bonded together by a commitment to the people who depend on our products every
day.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

downtime during the scale-up phase.

## APECS – European pilot line for advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration

APECS (Advanced Packaging and Heterogeneous Integration for Electronic Components and Systems) is a
European pilot line established under the EU Chips Act. It provides industry, SMEs and research
organizations with access to technologies, infrastructure and expertise for chiplet innovation,
system integration and industrial deployment. By connecting development, testing and pilot-scale
manufacturing, APECS accelerates the transition from research to application and strengthens
Europe’s semiconductor ecosystem.

## APECS – European pilot line for advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration

APECS (Advanced Packaging and Heterogeneous Integration for Electronic Components and Systems) is a
European pilot line established under the EU Chips Act. It provides industry, SMEs and research
organizations with access to technologies, infrastructure and expertise for chiplet innovation,
system integration and industrial deployment. By connecting development, testing and pilot-scale
manufacturing, APECS accelerates the transition from research to application and strengthens
Europe’s semiconductor ecosystem.

## **CHAPPER healthcare – a leading global specialist pharmaceutical wholesaler, distributor and

# Welcome to CHAPPER healthcare

CHAPPER healthcare is a leading global pharmaceutical distributor and wholesaler, specialising in
importing and exporting pharmaceuticals to markets across the globe since 1975.
* Importer & exporter of unlicensed / non-registered medicines
* Rapid response to market shortages & emergency medicines
* Complete range of temperature-controlled logistical solutions
* Pharmaceutical distribution services
* Significant expertise supplying to UK healthcare market and worldwide

We are a truly global company and regularly export to more than 70 different countries. We have
longstanding relationships with clients across Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia and the Americas.

CHAPPER healthcare builds on its legacy of export and wholesale services, now serving as the
European market access and distribution arm of [AscellaHealth][47] to leverage our shared expertise
in supporting partners globally.


# Our core values

## Supply chain integrity and security

All procedures are GMDP (Good Manufacturing & Distribution Practice) compliant.

## Ethical way of doing business

Patient safety is paramount and central to our core values and procedures. Honesty and transparency
guide the way we act across all aspects of our business. We build relationships for the long-term.

## Service

We differentiate ourselves by our emphasis on service quality. Our team are experienced,
professional and multilingual. We are bonded by a shared goal of delivering medicines to customers
around the world in a safe and efficient way.

## Global outlook

We supply clients in over 75 countries across the globe in all inhabited continents, we are a truly
global business.

## Quality of offering

Quality applies to every aspect of our business from the quality of medicinal products we supply to
the quality of service we offer our customers.

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

## BusKill: a USB kill cord

BusKill is a USB kill cord for your laptop. It is designed to protect your data if your device is
suddenly taken from you.

When the magnetic USB cable is disconnected (e.g., due to snatch-and-run theft), it triggers a
customisable security response: from locking your screen to shutting down or securely erasing
encryption keys.

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

### Clinical Trial Register

Search through multiple clinical trial registers in a single interface, connected to the drug
registration data and market data of PharmaFootpath.

This helps you to select a drug name or API, and then review global clinical trials currently
running with this.

### Drug Shortage Monitoring

Monitoring drug shortages is an important task, but the volume of information can be difficult to
manage.

PharmaFootpath collects and structures shortage information into a single interface, monitoring
trends to highlight the API with which there are increasing supply disruption signals.

## Built for Pharmaceutical Trade and Procurement

### Procurement Teams

Procurement teams can efficiently search multiple markets, compare pricing, and identify suppliers.

### Parallel Traders

Parallel traders can track product registrations, monitor competition, and find arbitrage
opportunities across EU markets.

### Clinical Trial Supply Teams

Clinical trial supply teams can identify global product availability and find new sourcing
opportunities.

### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers

Pharmaceutical wholesalers can find new suppliers, partners, and international trade opportunities.

databases, and verified sources. Shortage data is updated daily, and most datasets are refreshed

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

How does the AI research assistant work?

Is the data on MedPath Trial free to access?
Basic search and trial information is free. Pro and Team plans unlock advanced features like AI
research, data export, and priority support.
How often is the data updated?
Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What data sources does MedPath Trial use?
MedPath Trial aggregates data from ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP, EudraCT, and 12+ regulatory
agencies including FDA, EMA, NMPA, TGA, and Health Canada. All data is updated daily.
How does the AI research assistant work?
Our AI analyzes trial protocols, regulatory documents, and scientific literature to provide
insights. All AI-generated content includes source citations for verification.
Is the data on MedPath Trial free to access?
Basic search and trial information is free. Pro and Team plans unlock advanced features like AI
research, data export, and priority support.
How often is the data updated?
Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

the right products to sell both online and offline.

online environment.

demonstrating how modern online platforms are designed to engage users and provide accessible
experiences across different industries.

changing market.

## WOW CONGRESS

**WOW CONGRESS** is a destination of a **synergetic idea** and **expression**, where magic unleashes
and harness the **collective wisdom**, **experience** and **energy of inspirational** **women** and
**men** of all ages and backgrounds in service of our values and to **promote**, **communicate** and
**amplify** the influence of women and men in the workplace and beyond. We are committed to
**eliminate** **gender discrimination** and giving back to our growing worldwide community.

**WOW CONGRESS **believes that true empowerment for women cannot be achieved unless women themselves
support and uplift each other**. **As we come together in** solidarity, **we recognize that
empowerment is not just about individual success**, but about creating a network **of**
encouragement **and** mutual support **that** fosters growth **for all women. **Empowered women
empower others, **and in this collective effort, we create an environment where women can thrive not
only for themselves but for the generations to come.** As the founder of WOW CONGRESS wisely states,
“Women are a blessing to the world, there is no world without women.” **This belief is central to
our mission, as we continue to strengthen our collective voice and power through connection,
understanding, and action.**

****WOW CONGRESS** desires to bring people from across the globe and discuss how to **empower**,
**reshape** and **advance woman** with the proposition through our exclusive events for the
professional including **Medical** and **Healthcare**, **Information Technology**, **Business
Management** etc, where women are supporting other woman **ambition**, **aspiration**, **agility**
and **spirituality** in competent world and where they discuss, debate and dissect what the future
holds in a vibrant atmosphere by experiencing **integrative**, **responsible** and **socially
holistic environment** of opportunities and possibilities.

## WOW AWARDS

**WOW AWARDS** exclusive gateway for **inspiring stories of woman** across profession, who have been
leaving their footprint by generating **impactful change**, **driven by diversity**, **equity**, and
**inclusion** are at the forefront of every decision they make by rediscovering themselves with a
token of **Emotion**, **Embrace**, **Empathy** along with the notion of **Emerging**,
**Encouraging**, **Empowering** and **Enlightening of kinship and leadership**.

We believe a profound transformation for women across the globe beside all ages and marked a
significant turning point for **elevating** and **empowering** of **womanhood** by considering the
key global policy document on gender equality. It also sets strategic objectives and actions for the
advancement of women and the achievement of gender equality.

ACTIONABLE SESSIONS

With sessions and topics ranging from clinical to marketing, creating a profitable practice, **it
challenges and change your perspective and strive you for the better career**, you always wanted. It
helps you finding the clinical position of your dreams and more, you will find yourself seeing more
progress in these 2 days than most do in an entire year!

INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGY

Admiring emerging issues and get hands-on with the **cutting-edge technology** in the industry and
competitive analysis be on the forefront of **research and innovation** to create a seamless and
steadfast workflow at your practice.

INFLUENCING SPEAKERS

Get inspired with the best and brightest minds in **Healthcare & Tech industry** during captivation
sessions and assertive hands-on workshops. Get influenced by the **leading experts** and learn what
it takes to bring your practice to the next level with enhanced and assured patient care.

EXPLORING THE NETWORK

Grab the moment of cognizance and inspired, motivated, and empowered. **Interact and connect with
the peers and mentors to find support, leadership opportunities with guidance**. Gather glorify and
celebrate 2 days of networking with like-minded individuals.

CONTINUING EDUCATION

Collectively, comprehensive sessions and hands-on workshops with tons of takeaways to **instantly
enhance your practice and workflow** as soon as you return to your practice.

TEAM BUILDING

**WOW environment** is an impacting, not only your team members learn in educational scientific
sessions specifically designed for them, but **it’s a chance for everyone to have fun, building a
stronger bond out of your working environment and empowered**.

We develop, produce, and deliver high-quality, affordable medicines to more than 100 million people
in over 40 countries across Europe. Our four manufacturing sites and a broad network of external
manufacturing partners ensure supply security. Zentiva employs more than 5,400 unique talents in
over 30 countries, bonded together by a commitment to the people who depend on our products every
day.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
